modelingPolicy.sourceFacts: 每条已核事实与未知参数分离；本寄存器不提供研究峰值/临床成功率/准确净实现率。
modelingPolicy.researchForwardParameters: 具名自有或明确许可、适应症可识别项目可设透明研究peak,p,launch,netrate假设，带来源/理由和敏感性，不要求一切前瞻假设是公司历史披露。
modelingPolicy.unknownAssetMapping: 未名候选/合同无法与药物和适应症映射时保留零值观察；具名早期药也可选择零值下界，但不能称无价值/必败。
modelingPolicy.ownership: Global/internal/fullownership为定性；精确净实现率另作为研究假设；50% rights或profits与royalty不得互换。建议0/50/100权益敏感性。
modelingPolicy.expenses: 原明确年度总临床预算保留，逐药成本仅替代分配不重复；共享临床前/I安全、适应症人群和市场去重。
modelingPolicy.clinicalProbability: 临床阶段基准及BIO等统计可作为研究起点，按单药靶点、试验质量和适应症调整；不是公司获批概率事实。inactive美国口服与未进入CD试验不能共用中国III/UCIIa阶段。
modelingPolicy.historicalCash: 已收历史首款/里程碑只在历史现金桥；未来估值除去已收部分，不能把合约总额当剩余确定款。
modelingPolicy.contractCeilings: 一份合同全靶点/适应症只一次上限，除非公开逐项拆分；Bora框架正式合同未证。
modelingPolicy.timelines: III预计2029-10-30主要完成晚于三年目标，三年不得无据提前注册读出/批准；读出前有临床风险调整估值并说明。

perDrugAssumptions.classification: Research scenarios only; arrays bear/base/bull. Patient count is a financially accessible candidate population, not verified prevalence. All sales/price/share/launch/p/netRate are research assumptions; issuer identity, qualitative own-development or licensing and stage evidence remain separately in register.
perDrugAssumptions.method: peakUSDbn=patients*annualRealizedProductPriceUSD*share/1e9. For retained products netRate is research realization after hypothetical channels/license leakage; GM deducts production costs, incremental selling and all original clinical budgets are additional. For licensed royalties netRate is research royalty and GM reflects limited direct servicing costs, not full manufacture. No future unknown development milestone added.
perDrugAssumptions.probabilityPolicy: Reference phase I-to-approval overall about7.9%, oncology lower and validated non-oncology higher; candidate research values incorporate stage and direct evidence, not literal phase-average predictions. China IPF phase III base45% discounts small safety-primary IIa, 12-week followup, attrition and FVC missingness. US inactive and overseas unstarted pathways have lower probability and later launch; no target-year readout assumed before registered2029-10-30.
perDrugAssumptions.costPolicy: All nine legacy annual clinical cost totals are preserved in unallocated clinicalUnallocated, including active rows; row cost0 prevents fabricated allocation. Does not prove budget adequacy; +30% and +100% cost sensitivities required. Same molecule/indication regions never duplicate early trial costs.
perDrugAssumptions.ownershipPolicy: Internal/wholly-owned supports ownership1 research assumption, not unencumbered exact net right proof; Hygtia/Fosun50% follows disclosed economic interests. 0/50/100% retained-ownership and 0/50/100% licensed royalty sensitivities required with costs held unchanged.
perDrugAssumptions.overlapPolicy: IPF oral China, US, other territories disjoint. Inhaled uses only incrementally eligible/oral-intolerant patients, excludes oral addressable pool; no simultaneous full global market. UC geographic groups disjoint; CD separate diagnosis. MAT2A3412 selected MTAP-deleted non-GBM solid tumor pool explicitly excludes GBM reserved for0387; same eligible patient is not counted twice. Broad biomarker cancer rows defined as selected biomarker population, not every cancer type. TEAD other tumors/ENPP1/NLRP broad undeclared diseases and unspecified PCC directions remain zero where individual indication or region stage mapping insufficient.
perDrugAssumptions.geographicResearchPolicy: Explicit CN/US/OTHER rows disjoint; other disease, CD, PD, oncology and early PCC rows use one China plus potentially overseas financially accessible population research sum, not complete region-by-region rNPV. T2D non-obesity extensions are unverified research beyond obesity-related announcement context and must be zeroed if unsupported.
perDrugAssumptions.correlationPolicy: Same molecule across indication or territory shares safety/CMC risk; p values are marginal research weighting only, never independent joint approval probabilities. GIPR and MAT2A disjoint research pools require evidence to validate.
perDrugAssumptions.earlyPolicy: PCC candidates with explicit disease and own-development identity have separately sized narrow demand; broad unnamed disease groups remain zero. ISM0676/1354 obesity pools are differentiated combo segments, not two complete GLP1 global markets. NR3C1 hypercortisol obesity is not general obesity. Early probabilities discount absence of human disease evidence.

earlyRows.reason: older GIPR PCC, selected injectable-combo eligible pool; mouse weight data not human, oral PK and combination burden.
new GIPR not same drug0676; disjoint later/optimized combo demand, no generic GLP1 total market.
non-obesity T2D selected add-on pool, excludes obesity rows and CV benefits; no patient efficacy.
later differentiated T2D pool disjoint0676 hypothetical share; excludes obesity co-diagnosis double revenue.
MTAP-deleted glioblastoma PCC, brain exposure animal only; very low oncology/CNS probability; broad other tumors zero.
NR3C1 narrow Cushing refractory, long glucocorticoid safety unknown.
hypercortisol subset excludes Cushing and general GLP1 obesity; no clinical metabolic safety.
selected refractory glaucoma, current low-cost eye drugs cap realized price and share; animal only.
annual equivalent is short treatment-course per patient, not chronic annual opioid-like price; acute surgery pool.
refractory neuropathic chronic pain, excludes acute course patients; placebo/endpoints and generics.
dryAMD selected progressive segment; retinal exposure animal not visual outcome.
refractory uveitis separate diagnosis, steroid/biologic competitors.
selected inflammatory dry-eye not all dry-eye prevalence; topical low pricing and endpoints.
high Lpa/ASCVD eligible accessible pool, CV-event evidence needed, primate biomarker not patient outcomes.

rows.reason: China III recruiting, primary completion2029-10-30; accessible treated segment, not total IPF prevalence. IIa primarily safety with incomplete FVC, price reflects China access.
US oral IND inactive; new local development/partner needed. Net realization is hypothetical licensing/channel outcome, no assumed existing agreement.
ex-US/China accessible markets; no active local registered trial verified, later bridge and reimbursement.
IND but no human efficacy; incremental oral-intolerant/eligible pool, device/airway tolerability and adherence matter.
no local overseas IND, separate inhalation validation and partner. Selected incremental pool excludes oral demand.
UC IIa patient trial about80, no efficacy results; oral adjunct/alternative faces JAK/IL23 and pricing pressure.
healthy phase I not UC efficacy; overseas separate clinical bridge. Disjoint China territory.
CD lacks distinct patient trial; disease complexity and competing biologics reduce probability vs UC, not copy UC IIa stage.
biomarker-selected refractory MTAP-deleted non-GBM eligible segment excludes GBM counted0387, phase I no mature ORR; no full pan-cancer global peak.
unresectable previously treated mesothelioma, fast-track not efficacy; ESMO results cutoff excluded; broad other tumors zero.
PD not yet patient efficacy, disease-modification difficult; disclosed50% interests and separate full R&D cost retained.
Exelixis exclusive royalty, range supports rate research not exact tier; HRD/BRCA selected resistant population, trial Ia historical.
KAT6 Stemline license, refractory ER+/HER2- market, no mature comparative response; capped cost reimbursements not free development.
KIF18A/MEN2501 distinct from KAT6; first patient milestone historical only, CIN biomarker selected refractory pool.
Fosun QPCTL joint development profits/losses50/50, not royalty. Selected solid cancer responsive pool, later phase duties unknown.
separate B-cell lymphoma patient pool and competing CD20/CAR-T, same50% QPCTL ownership; no duplicated early cost.
TaiGen GreaterChina exclusive, healthy I not patient benefit; HIF class competing prices and safety. Net rate research royalty.
retained ex-GreaterChina, no local approved clinical pathway verified, separate later development; no TaiGen China royalty counted twice.
